Value: Compute hillshade from G09 CLEAN DEM using GDAL gdaldem hillshade. Parameters: Azimuth = 315 degrees (NW illumination); Altitude = 45 degrees. See TERRAIN_PROCESSING_DECISIONS.csv DEC06. Output: byte raster (0–255) representing shaded relief.
None (visualisation product only — not used as analytical input)
MAP_07_Terrain_Elevation, MAP_08_Hillshade — used as base layer in all terrain and risk maps for visual context

Hillshade is a VISUALISATION LAYER ONLY. It must not be used as an analytical input to any indicator, index, or risk model. It is used as a background layer in map compositions to improve terrain readability. Azimuth 315 / altitude 45 are conventional standards — see DEC06 in TERRAIN_PROCESSING_DECISIONS.csv.
